entry.summaryHtml: Chestnut, baking spice, coffee bean, cedar and gentle natural sweetness give Cubanitos a compact, aromatic Cameroon profile. The narrow format should keep the wrapper lively and woody, with coffee and toasted nuts through the middle and a dry cedar-spice finish softened by mild sweetness.
